parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the refrigerator is made of stainless steel, providing structural support and housing for internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors, insulation, and internal compartments, maintaining the refrigerator’s rigidity and durability.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Door (Left)
parts.Basic_description: The left door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, provides access to one of the compartments.
parts.Functional_description: It seals the compartment to maintain temperature and can be opened or closed by the user.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about its hinge to open and close.

parts.name: Door (Right)
parts.Basic_description: The right door of the refrigerator, made of stainless steel, typically provides access to the main cooling compartment.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to access stored food and beverages and maintains an airtight seal when closed.
parts.Movement_description: The door swings open and closed on its hinge mechanism.

parts.name: Side Controls
parts.Basic_description: The side control panel is made of plastic and contains buttons or a touch interface for adjusting refrigerator settings.
parts.Functional_description: It allows users to control temperature, modes, and other operational settings of the refrigerator.
parts.Movement_description: The control buttons or touch interface may have small actuation movements when pressed or touched.
